title: ONI Companion Screen (v1, additions in v1.1)
description: FROZEN. One page of content. All text, order and numbers are decided by the core; the front end only renders `blocks` top to bottom and navigates Refs.

source.description: Where the numbers came from. mod-live/save/header for colony data; mod-export/yaml for game data; none when empty.

back.description: Where Back goes if the client has no history. A Ref, or the string "home".

refreshOn.description: Re-fetch this Screen when /events reports one of these.

onOpen.description: v1.1. Actions the front end runs once, when the page is opened by the user. Not again on refresh, on Back, or when the page is re-fetched after an event. Only the core decides whether this is present (e.g. the setting 'zoom to duplicant when selected').

filter.description: v1.1. Show a text field. The front end hides list items and grid cards whose title does not contain the text (case-insensitive) and re-fetches nothing.

worldSwitcher.description: v1.1. Show a world picker. Choosing a world re-fetches this same URL with ?world=<id>.

raw.description: Only on GET /colony (see api.schema.json ColonyReply). Other endpoints leave it out.
